assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area geometries come from repository provisional rough polygons rather than official CAD/GIS redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive design layers, ratios, figures, drawings and local visual values must be recalculated when official geometry is released; no statutory or scoring-quality boundary claim is made.

assumptions.statement: No cleared parcel, building survey, heritage-control, road-redline, rail, utility, fire, flood or ownership geometry is in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints, renewal categories, access lines and heritage interfaces are conceptual placeholders and require professional survey and multi-disciplinary validation.

assumptions.statement: Scenario cards, governance protocols and annual activity mechanisms are reference recommendations for future operators.
assumptions.impact: They do not constitute approved services, procurement, funding, personal-data collection or agency commitments.
